entities.summary: Giorgi Abramishvili Military Hospital of the Ministry of Defence of Georgia, also known as the Gori Military Hospital, is a medical facility operated by the Ministry of Defense of Georgia and located in the city of Gori. In its current form, the center was established on 15 August 2006, succeeding the Soviet-era military hospital based in Georgia's capital of Tbilisi.
